main_measure.name: mean 20-bar fwd return in-position minus all bars (non-overlapping)
main_measure.threshold: difference above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; difference <= 0 rejects

supporting_check.name: up-cross positive 20-bar share minus unconditional share

decided_by: Fewer than the required minimums (13 in-position non-overlapping blocks vs 15, 2 up-crosses vs 8), so the test neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: Pooled all windows of every coin present, used the 0,20,40,... grid per window for both groups with Welch t, counted an up-cross as a bar with forecast > 0 after a bar with forecast <= 0 inside the same window that has a full 20-bar forward return, took the unconditional share over every bar with a valid 20-bar forward return, and applied the minimum counts first, then reject, then confirm.
